name: Orgo
description: Cloud Linux and Windows computers for AI agents: each is an isolated VM with a desktop, browser and terminal that agents drive via API, SDKs, CLI or hosted MCP.

skills.name: Launch Cloud Computers
skills.description: Create, stop and resume persistent Linux or Windows VMs, each with its own disk, desktop, browser and terminal.

skills.name: Control a Desktop
skills.description: Take screenshots, click, drag, type, press keys and scroll on a cloud computer's screen for computer-use agents.

skills.name: Run Bash and Python
skills.description: Execute shell commands and Python on a cloud computer, and upload, export or download files from it.

skills.name: Embed a Live Screen
skills.description: Put a live computer screen in your own app over VNC, or share an app running on the computer at a public URL.
